name: resistance band serratus wall slide
description: Wall slide with a band around the forearms to engage the serratus. It improves shoulder blade control.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a band around your forearms just below the elbows.
Place your forearms on the wall and push slightly outward against the band.
Slide your arms up the wall, reaching overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulder blades moving freely.
